scope: Exact declaration bytes and ELF PT_LOAD metadata/content, not semantic equivalence or execution timing.

completeRecordDigest.format: Lexicographically sorted(kind,symbol); each compact ASCII JSON [kind,symbol,status,old,new] followed by LF; old/new null or [bytes,sha256,newlines].

declarationComparison.topRanking: Descending absolute byte delta, then larger old/new body size, kind and full symbol.
